build_multigrid_environment: create a multigrid multiagent gym environment wrapped for dm_env using make_multigrid_environment
wrap_multigrid_env: wrap a multigrid environment with MultigridWrapper to use it as a dm_env environment
convert_observation_format: convert multigrid observations from key-first to agent-index-first format using dict_obs_to_list_obs
convert_gym_space_to_spec: convert an OpenAI Gym space to a dm_env spec using _gym_to_spec
convert_to_multiagent_spec: convert a multigrid gym space to an Acme multiagent spec using _convert_to_spec
